name: Schism
description: A fold in space created by Hauc's failed bomb that sucks up ghosts of those who died in Utvara.

description_citations.text: "Zomaj Hauc". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Uncle reveals he had Hauc drop the mana bomb; it goes awry, creating the Schism and mutating the plague.
timeline.quote: the explosion creates a weird wrinkle in the sky called the Schism and causes the plague to mutate.

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kos studies the Schism and sees the Kuga mot while searching for Feather and Parhelion.
timeline.quote: The Kuga Mot appears, a mysterious glowing sphere or apparition

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A new Guildpact is created, the Schism fades and Agyrem overlays Ravnica; Kos becomes Boros commander there.
timeline.quote: Kos accepts the task of becoming the Boros commander for that area.

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Epilogue". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaluzax deploys a prototype bomb on Hauc's orders; instead of exploding it forms the Schism, draining life and trapping spirits.
timeline.quote: Instead of exploding, the device formed a warped rift in the sky

citation.text: "Utvara Valley", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The explosion tears open the Schism; every soul in Utvara is ripped from its body and the Schism snags Agyrem.
timeline.quote: every soul in Utvara was ripped from their bodies

citation.text: "Creation of the Schism", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hauc explodes a bomb above the Utvara Reclamation Zone, which kills the local Gruul by implosion but creates the Schism instead of exploding.
timeline.quote: The machine killed all the local Gruul with an implosion but didn't explode.

citation.text: "Zomaj Hauc", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
